summary.text: Ed Price is a Democratic member of the Louisiana Senate for District 2, representing Ascension, Assumption, Iberville, Lafourche, St. James, St. John the Baptist, West Baton Rouge, according to the Senate member page.
The Senate biography says Price chairs the Senate Retirement Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Senate biography, Price was elected to the Ascension Parish School Board in 1985, served 27 years as a board member and 12 years as board president, and was elected president of the Louisiana School Board Association in 2007.

It says he was elected to the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 58 in 2012, re-elected in 2015, and then elected to the Louisiana State Senate for District 2 in 2017 and re-elected in 2019.
The biography lists him as Vice-Chairman of the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus from 2012 to 2015 and of the Louisiana Democratic Caucus from 2016 to 2017.

The biography says Price graduated from Grambling State University, served 20 years on the board of Wymar Federal Credit Union, and is a retiree of BASF Corporation with more than 36 years of service.

The Senate member page lists Ed Price's committee assignments as Retirement (Chair); Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs; Environmental Quality; Transportation, Highways and Public Works; Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Capital Region Legislative Delegation; Democratic Caucus; Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
